title: AI Glasses vs AR Glasses: Do They All Have a Screen?
headline:
AI glasses
do not all have screens.
meaning: Audio, cameras and displays are different features.
example: A voice assistant can respond without a visual overlay.
comparison: An AI assistant is different from an AR display.
caution: Check the exact model and recording indicators.
question: Would you prefer audio or a display?
lines: When you hear A I glasses, do you imagine a screen floating in front of your eyes? Not every pair has one.
Glasses can combine microphones, speakers, cameras, and an assistant. The exact features depend on the model.
An audio focused pair may answer through speakers without showing a visual interface in the lens.
An augmented reality display is a separate capability. The labels A I and A R are not interchangeable.
Before choosing, check the specific hardware, phone connection, available features, and recording indicators.
